answer: Ephemeral Nonce Ceremony. Each identity must, at a random dawn window, solve a fresh challenge derived from live hardware entropy plus its own prior output, then publish the preimage before expiry. A founding haven of nodes verifies timing and uniqueness; replay fails. An attacker must run distinct physical devices continuously, paying hardware, power, and idle time per sybil—no fable of shared work passes, since each answer is unrepeatable and expiring.
